observations.text: Official manual: PRC-61 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-61 stage 1, HAP-96 changes into CYN-94.
In PRC-61 stage 2, CYN-94 changes into FAR-41.
In PRC-61 stage 4, JOT-28 changes into terminal marker HAP-48.

In PRC-94 stage 1, SIV-14 changes into KEL-58.
In PRC-94 stage 2, KEL-58 changes into PEL-73.
In PRC-94 stage 4, RAV-47 changes into terminal marker WAM-15.
Official manual: PRC-48 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-48 stage 1, VOR-86 changes into MUR-81.
In PRC-48 stage 2, MUR-81 changes into ZIR-79.
In PRC-48 stage 4, TEK-38 changes into terminal marker VOR-75.
